problem: The sentence 'The barrel jack takes 7–12 V and an onboard regulator makes the 5 V' follows 'Uno, Nano and Mega are 5 V boards', so it reads as applying to all three. The Nano has no barrel jack at all; it is powered from USB or from the Vin pin.
fix: Say: 'The Uno and Mega have a barrel jack that takes 7–12 V, and an onboard regulator makes the 5 V. The Nano has no barrel jack: power it from USB, or feed 7–12 V into its Vin pin, which goes through its own small regulator.'

problem: Pin labels are given as 'digital pins 0–13, analog inputs A0–A5' as if this were true of every board, but the table two paragraphs later gives the Nano 8 analog inputs and the Mega 54 digital and 16 analog pins. A student will not know which statement to trust.
fix: Say: 'On the Uno the pins are labelled digital 0–13 and analog A0–A5. The Nano adds A6 and A7; the Mega has far more of both.'

problem: 'When memory runs out you change the board, not the code' is too strong. Many sketches fit after small code changes such as storing text in flash with the F() macro or PROGMEM, or using smaller integer types.
fix: Say: 'You cannot add RAM the way you add a stick to a PC. Shrink the code (flash-resident strings, smaller variable types) first, and move to a bigger board only when that is not enough.'

problem: 'The compiler underneath is a C++ compiler for the AVR chip' is written as a general fact about Arduino, but only AVR boards use that compiler; ESP32, STM32 and other families bring their own C++ toolchains through their board packages.
fix: Say: 'the language is C++ and the board package supplies the matching C++ compiler — AVR-GCC for the Uno's ATmega328P, another toolchain for other families.'

problem: 'loop() repeats thousands of times a second' is not generally true: a single delay(1000) inside loop() makes one pass per second. The wording can confuse a student who has just computed a 1 Hz blink.
fix: Say: 'loop() repeats without end, as fast as its own code allows — thousands of times a second for an empty loop, once a second if it contains delay(1000).'
